messages.content: What is Reitit and how do I define routes?

Reitit is a fast, data-driven router for Clojure/Script. Routes are defined as vectors of paths and optional data.

**Setup**
```clojure
;; deps.edn
{:deps {metosin/reitit {:mvn/version "0.7.0"}}}

(require '[reitit.core :as r])
```

**Basic Route Definition**
```clojure
;; Routes are vectors: [path data? child-routes?]
(def router
  (r/router
    [["/" {:name ::home}]
     ["/about" {:name ::about}]
     ["/users" {:name ::users}]
     ["/users/:id" {:name ::user}]]))

;; Match by path
(r/match-by-path router "/users/123")
;; => {:template "/users/:id"
;;     :data {:name :myapp.core/user}
;;     :path-params {:id "123"}
;;     :path "/users/123"}

;; Match by name
(r/match-by-name router ::user {:id 123})
;; => {:template "/users/:id"
;;     :data {:name :myapp.core/user}
;;     :path-params {:id "123"}
;;     :path "/users/123"}
```

**Nested Routes**
```clojure
(def router
  (r/router
    [["/api"
      ["/users"
       ["" {:name ::user-list
            :get {:handler list-users}}]
       ["/:id"
        ["" {:name ::user
             :get {:handler get-user}
             :put {:handler update-user}
             :delete {:handler delete-user}}]
        ["/posts" {:name ::user-posts
                   :get {:handler get-user-posts}}]]]
      ["/posts"
       ["" {:name ::post-list}]
       ["/:id" {:name ::post}]]]]))

;; Results in paths:
;; /api/users
;; /api/users/:id
;; /api/users/:id/posts
;; /api/posts
;; /api/posts/:id
```

**Path Parameters**
```clojure
;; Basic parameter
["/users/:id"]

;; Multiple parameters
["/users/:user-id/posts/:post-id"]

;; Wildcard (catch-all)
["/files/*path"]  ; Matches /files/a/b/c => {:path "a/b/c"}

;; Regex constraints (reitit-ring)
["/users/:id" {:parameters {:path {:id int?}}}]
```

**Route Data**
```clojure
;; Route data is merged from parent to child
(def router
  (r/router
    [["/api" {:middleware [wrap-api]}  ; Applied to all /api routes
      ["/public"
       ["/health" {:name ::health}]]
      ["/admin" {:middleware [wrap-auth]}  ; Additional middleware
       ["/users" {:name ::admin-users}]
       ["/settings" {:name ::admin-settings}]]]]
    {:data {:middleware [wrap-defaults]}}))

;; /api/admin/users gets:
;; {:middleware [wrap-defaults wrap-api wrap-auth], :name ::admin-users}
```

**HTTP Method Handlers**
```clojure
;; Method-specific handlers
(def routes
  [["/users"
    {:get {:handler list-users
           :summary "List all users"}
     :post {:handler create-user
            :summary "Create a user"
            :parameters {:body UserSchema}}}]
   ["/users/:id"
    {:get {:handler get-user}
     :put {:handler update-user}
     :patch {:handler patch-user}
     :delete {:handler delete-user}}]])
```

**Query Parameters**
```clojure
;; Query params are handled at handler level
(defn list-users [request]
  (let [{:keys [page limit]} (:query-params request)]
    {:status 200
     :body (fetch-users {:page (or page 1)
                         :limit (or limit 20)})}))

;; With reitit-ring coercion
(def routes
  [["/users" {:get {:parameters {:query {:page int?
                                          :limit int?}}
                    :handler list-users}}]])
```
How do I use Reitit with Ring for HTTP routing?

Reitit provides `reitit.ring` for integrating with Ring HTTP handlers. **Basic Ring Router** ```clojure (require '[reitit.ring :as ring]) ;; Define handlers (defn home-handler [_] {:status 200 :headers {"Content-Type" "text/html"} :body "

Home

"}) (defn user-handler [{:keys [path-params]}] {:status 200 :headers {"Content-Type" "application/json"} :body (str "{\"id\": \"" (:id path-params) "\"}")}) ;; Create ring handler (def app (ring/ring-handler (ring/router [["/" {:get home-handler}] ["/users/:id" {:get user-handler}]]))) ;; Call it (app {:request-method :get :uri "/users/123"}) ;; => {:status 200 :body "{\"id\": \"123\"}" ...} ``` **With Middleware** ```clojure (require '[ring.middleware.params :refer [wrap-params]] '[ring.middleware.json :refer [wrap-json-body wrap-json-response]]) (def app (ring/ring-handler (ring/router [["/api" ["/users" {:get list-users :post create-user}] ["/users/:id" {:get get-user :put update-user :delete delete-user}]]] {:data {:middleware [wrap-params wrap-json-body wrap-json-response]}}))) ``` **Default Handler (404)** ```clojure (defn not-found-handler [_] {:status 404 :body {:error "Not found"}}) (def app (ring/ring-handler (ring/router routes) not-found-handler)) ; Called when no route matches ;; Or with create-default-handler (def app (ring/ring-handler (ring/router routes) (ring/create-default-handler {:not-found (constantly {:status 404 :body "Not found"}) :method-not-allowed (constantly {:status 405 :body "Method not allowed"}) :not-acceptable (constantly {:status 406 :body "Not acceptable"})}))) ``` **Complete API Example** ```clojure (ns myapp.api (:require [reitit.ring :as ring] [reitit.ring.middleware.parameters :as parameters] [reitit.ring.middleware.exception :as exception] [ring.adapter.jetty :as jetty])) ;; Handlers (defn list-users [_] {:status 200 :body {:users [{:id 1 :name "Alice"} {:id 2 :name "Bob"}]}}) (defn get-user [{:keys [path-params]}] (let [id (Integer/parseInt (:id path-params))] {:status 200 :body {:id id :name "User"}})) (defn create-user [{:keys [body-params]}] {:status 201 :body (assoc body-params :id (rand-int 10000))}) ;; Routes (def routes [["/api" ["/health" {:get (fn [_] {:status 200 :body {:status "ok"}})}] ["/users" ["" {:get list-users :post create-user}] ["/:id" {:get get-user}]]]]) ;; App (def app (ring/ring-handler (ring/router routes {:data {:middleware [parameters/parameters-middleware exception/exception-middleware]}}) (ring/create-default-handler))) ;; Start server (defn -main [] (jetty/run-jetty #'app {:port 3000 :join? false}) (println "Server running on http://localhost:3000")) ``` **Accessing Route Data in Handlers** ```clojure (defn my-handler [request] (let [;; Path parameters path-params (:path-params request) ;; Query parameters (need wrap-params middleware) query-params (:query-params request) ;; Body (need body parsing middleware) body (:body-params request) ;; Route match info match (:reitit.core/match request) ;; Route data route-data (:data match) ;; Route name route-name (:name route-data)] {:status 200 :body {:path-params path-params :route-name route-name}})) ;; Access in middleware (defn wrap-logging [handler] (fn [request] (let [match (:reitit.core/match request) route-name (-> match :data :name)] (println "Handling route:" route-name) (handler request)))) ```
How do I add parameter coercion and validation in Reitit?

Reitit supports parameter coercion with various schema libraries. Malli coercion is most popular.

**Setup with Malli**
```clojure
(require '[reitit.ring :as ring]
         '[reitit.coercion.malli :as malli]
         '[reitit.ring.coercion :as coercion]
         '[reitit.ring.middleware.parameters :as parameters])
```

**Basic Parameter Coercion**
```clojure
(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      [["/api/users/:id"
        {:get {:parameters {:path {:id :int}}
               :handler (fn [{{{:keys [id]} :path} :parameters}]
                          {:status 200
                           :body {:id id :type (type id)}})}}]]
      {:data {:coercion malli/coercion
              :middleware [parameters/parameters-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-request-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-response-middleware]}})))

;; GET /api/users/123 => {:id 123 :type java.lang.Long}
;; Path param "123" was coerced to integer
```

**All Parameter Types**
```clojure
(def routes
  [["/api/search"
    {:get {:parameters {:query {:q :string
                                :page :int
                                :limit :int
                                :tags [:vector :string]}}
           :handler search-handler}}]
   
   ["/api/users/:id"
    {:parameters {:path {:id :int}}  ; Shared across methods
     :get {:handler get-user}
     :put {:parameters {:body [:map
                               [:name :string]
                               [:email :string]]}
           :handler update-user}}]
   
   ["/api/upload"
    {:post {:parameters {:multipart {:file :any
                                     :description :string}}
            :handler upload-handler}}]])

;; In handler, access via :parameters
(defn update-user [{:keys [parameters]}]
  (let [id (-> parameters :path :id)
        body (-> parameters :body)]
    {:status 200
     :body (db/update-user id body)}))
```

**Response Coercion**
```clojure
(def routes
  [["/api/users/:id"
    {:get {:parameters {:path {:id :int}}
           :responses {200 {:body [:map
                                   [:id :int]
                                   [:name :string]
                                   [:email :string]]}}
           :handler get-user}}]])

;; Response body is validated/coerced against schema
```

**Custom Malli Schemas**
```clojure
(def User
  [:map
   [:id :int]
   [:name [:string {:min 1}]]
   [:email [:re #".+@.+\..+"]]
   [:role [:enum :admin :user :guest]]])

(def CreateUserRequest
  [:map
   [:name [:string {:min 1}]]
   [:email [:re #".+@.+\..+"]]
   [:role {:optional true} [:enum :admin :user :guest]]])

(def routes
  [["/api/users"
    {:post {:parameters {:body CreateUserRequest}
            :responses {201 {:body User}}
            :handler create-user}}]
   ["/api/users/:id"
    {:get {:parameters {:path {:id :int}}
           :responses {200 {:body User}
                       404 {:body [:map [:error :string]]}}
           :handler get-user}}]])
```

**Error Handling**
```clojure
(require '[reitit.ring.middleware.exception :as exception])

;; Custom coercion error handler
(defn coercion-error-handler [status]
  (fn [exception _]
    {:status status
     :body {:error "Validation failed"
            :details (-> exception ex-data :errors)}}))

(def exception-middleware
  (exception/create-exception-middleware
    (merge
      exception/default-handlers
      {:reitit.coercion/request-coercion (coercion-error-handler 400)
       :reitit.coercion/response-coercion (coercion-error-handler 500)})))

(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:coercion malli/coercion
              :middleware [parameters/parameters-middleware
                           exception-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-request-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-response-middleware]}})))
```

**With Registry**
```clojure
(require '[malli.core :as m]
         '[malli.registry :as mr])

(def registry
  {:user/id :int
   :user/name [:string {:min 1}]
   :user/email [:re #".+@.+\..+"]
   :user/user [:map
               [:id :user/id]
               [:name :user/name]
               [:email :user/email]]})

;; Create coercion with custom registry
(def my-coercion
  (malli/create
    {:compile m/validator
     :strip-extra-keys true
     :error-keys #{:type :in :schema :value :errors}
     :transformers {:body {:default malli/default-transformer
                           :formats {"application/json" malli/json-transformer}}
                    :string {:default malli/string-transformer}
                    :response {:default malli/default-transformer}}
     :registry (mr/composite-registry m/default-registry registry)}))

(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:coercion my-coercion ...}})))
```
How do I add middleware to Reitit routes?

Reitit supports both global and route-specific middleware with a data-driven approach.

**Middleware Options**
```clojure
;; 1. Global middleware (via :data)
(ring/router routes {:data {:middleware [mw1 mw2]}})

;; 2. Route-level middleware (merged with global)
[["/admin" {:middleware [auth-mw]}
  ["/users" ...]]]

;; 3. Method-level middleware
[["/users" {:get {:middleware [cache-mw]
                   :handler ...}}]]
```

**Basic Middleware Setup**
```clojure
(require '[reitit.ring :as ring]
         '[reitit.ring.middleware.parameters :as parameters])

;; Ring-style middleware
(defn wrap-logging [handler]
  (fn [request]
    (println "Request:" (:uri request) (:request-method request))
    (let [response (handler request)]
      (println "Response:" (:status response))
      response)))

(defn wrap-timing [handler]
  (fn [request]
    (let [start (System/currentTimeMillis)
          response (handler request)
          duration (- (System/currentTimeMillis) start)]
      (assoc-in response [:headers "X-Response-Time"] (str duration "ms")))))

(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:middleware [wrap-logging
                           wrap-timing
                           parameters/parameters-middleware]}})))
```

**Data-Driven Middleware**
```clojure
(require '[reitit.ring.middleware.middleware :as middleware])

;; Define middleware as data
(def logging-middleware
  {:name ::logging
   :wrap (fn [handler]
           (fn [request]
             (println "Request:" (:uri request))
             (handler request)))})

(def auth-middleware
  {:name ::auth
   :compile (fn [{:keys [auth]} _]
              (when auth
                (fn [handler]
                  (fn [request]
                    (if (authenticated? request)
                      (handler request)
                      {:status 401 :body "Unauthorized"})))))})

;; Use in routes
(def routes
  [["/api"
    {:middleware [logging-middleware]}
    ["/public" {:get public-handler}]
    ["/private" {:auth true  ; Triggers auth-middleware
                 :middleware [auth-middleware]
                 :get private-handler}]]])
```

**Middleware with Options**
```clojure
;; Middleware that reads route data
(def role-middleware
  {:name ::require-role
   :compile (fn [{:keys [roles]} _]
              (when roles
                (fn [handler]
                  (fn [request]
                    (let [user-role (get-in request [:user :role])]
                      (if (contains? roles user-role)
                        (handler request)
                        {:status 403 :body "Forbidden"}))))))})

;; Usage
[["/admin"
  {:middleware [role-middleware]
   :roles #{:admin}}  ; Passed to middleware compile
  ["/users" {:get admin-list-users}]
  ["/settings" {:get admin-settings}]]]
```

**Middleware Order**
```clojure
;; Middleware runs in order: first wraps last
{:middleware [mw1 mw2 mw3]}
;; Request flow:  mw1 -> mw2 -> mw3 -> handler
;; Response flow: mw1 <- mw2 <- mw3 <- handler

;; Example: timing should be first (outermost)
(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:middleware [wrap-timing       ; First: measure total time
                           wrap-logging      ; Second: log request
                           wrap-params       ; Third: parse params
                           wrap-json-body    ; Fourth: parse JSON
                           wrap-exception]}})))  ; Fifth: handle errors
```

**Built-in Middleware**
```clojure
(require '[reitit.ring.middleware.parameters :as parameters]
         '[reitit.ring.middleware.exception :as exception]
         '[reitit.ring.coercion :as coercion]
         '[reitit.ring.middleware.muuntaja :as muuntaja]
         '[muuntaja.core :as m])

(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:muuntaja m/instance
              :coercion malli/coercion
              :middleware [;; Query/form params
                           parameters/parameters-middleware
                           ;; Content negotiation
                           muuntaja/format-negotiate-middleware
                           ;; Response formatting
                           muuntaja/format-response-middleware
                           ;; Exception handling
                           exception/exception-middleware
                           ;; Request body parsing
                           muuntaja/format-request-middleware
                           ;; Coercion
                           coercion/coerce-request-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-response-middleware]}})))
```

**Route-Specific Middleware**
```clojure
(def routes
  [["/api" {:middleware [wrap-api]}
    
    ;; Public routes - no auth
    ["/health" {:get health-handler}]
    ["/login" {:post login-handler}]
    
    ;; Protected routes - add auth
    ["/protected" {:middleware [wrap-auth]}
      ["/profile" {:get profile-handler}]
      ["/settings" {:get settings-handler
                    :put {:middleware [wrap-validate-settings]
                          :handler update-settings}}]]
    
    ;; Admin routes - auth + admin role
    ["/admin" {:middleware [wrap-auth wrap-admin]}
      ["/users" {:get list-users}]]]])
```
How do I generate OpenAPI/Swagger documentation from Reitit routes?

Reitit can automatically generate OpenAPI 3.x documentation from your routes.

**Setup**
```clojure
;; deps.edn
{:deps {metosin/reitit {:mvn/version "0.7.0"}
        metosin/reitit-swagger {:mvn/version "0.7.0"}
        metosin/reitit-swagger-ui {:mvn/version "0.7.0"}}}

(require '[reitit.ring :as ring]
         '[reitit.swagger :as swagger]
         '[reitit.swagger-ui :as swagger-ui]
         '[reitit.coercion.malli :as malli]
         '[reitit.ring.coercion :as coercion])
```

**Basic Swagger Setup**
```clojure
(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      [["/swagger.json"
        {:get {:no-doc true  ; Exclude from docs
               :swagger {:info {:title "My API"
                                :description "API Description"
                                :version "1.0.0"}}
               :handler (swagger/create-swagger-handler)}}]
       
       ["/api"
        ["/users"
         {:get {:summary "List all users"
                :description "Returns a list of all users"
                :responses {200 {:body [:vector User]}}
                :handler list-users}
          :post {:summary "Create user"
                 :parameters {:body CreateUserRequest}
                 :responses {201 {:body User}}
                 :handler create-user}}]]]
      
      {:data {:coercion malli/coercion
              :middleware [coercion/coerce-request-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-response-middleware]}})))
```

**With Swagger UI**
```clojure
(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      [["/swagger.json"
        {:get {:no-doc true
               :swagger {:info {:title "My API" :version "1.0.0"}}
               :handler (swagger/create-swagger-handler)}}]
       
       ["/api" ...routes...]])
    
    (ring/routes
      ;; Serve Swagger UI at /api-docs
      (swagger-ui/create-swagger-ui-handler
        {:path "/api-docs"
         :url "/swagger.json"
         :config {:validatorUrl nil}})
      (ring/create-default-handler))))
```

**Documenting Routes**
```clojure
(def routes
  [["/api"
    {:swagger {:tags ["api"]}}  ; Tag for grouping
    
    ["/users"
     {:swagger {:tags ["users"]}}
     ["" {:get {:summary "List users"
                :description "Get paginated list of users"
                :parameters {:query {:page int?
                                     :limit int?}}
                :responses {200 {:body {:users [:vector User]
                                        :total int?}}}
                :handler list-users}
           
           :post {:summary "Create user"
                  :description "Create a new user account"
                  :parameters {:body CreateUserRequest}
                  :responses {201 {:body User}
                              400 {:body {:error string?}}}
                  :handler create-user}}]
     
     ["/:id"
      {:parameters {:path {:id int?}}}
      ["" {:get {:summary "Get user"
                 :responses {200 {:body User}
                             404 {:body {:error string?}}}
                 :handler get-user}
           
           :put {:summary "Update user"
                 :parameters {:body UpdateUserRequest}
                 :responses {200 {:body User}}
                 :handler update-user}
           
           :delete {:summary "Delete user"
                    :responses {204 {:body nil}}
                    :handler delete-user}}]]]]])
```

**OpenAPI 3.0 Metadata**
```clojure
["/api/login"
 {:post {:summary "User login"
         :description "Authenticate user and return JWT token"
         :swagger {:security []  ; No auth required
                   :consumes ["application/json"]
                   :produces ["application/json"]}
         :parameters {:body {:email string?
                             :password string?}}
         :responses {200 {:body {:token string?}
                          :description "Login successful"}
                     401 {:body {:error string?}
                          :description "Invalid credentials"}}
         :handler login-handler}}]

["/api/protected"
 {:swagger {:security [{:bearer []}]}  ; Requires auth
  :get {:summary "Protected resource"
        :handler protected-handler}}]
```

**Schema Definitions**
```clojure
;; Define schemas with OpenAPI metadata
(def User
  [:map {:swagger/example {:id 1 :name "Alice" :email "alice@example.com"}}
   [:id :int]
   [:name [:string {:swagger/description "User's full name"}]]
   [:email [:string {:swagger/format "email"}]]])

(def CreateUserRequest
  [:map
   [:name [:string {:min 1 :swagger/description "Required name"}]]
   [:email [:string {:swagger/format "email"}]]
   [:password [:string {:min 8 :swagger/format "password"}]]])
```

**Complete Example**
```clojure
(ns myapp.api
  (:require [reitit.ring :as ring]
            [reitit.swagger :as swagger]
            [reitit.swagger-ui :as swagger-ui]
            [reitit.coercion.malli :as malli]
            [reitit.ring.coercion :as coercion]
            [reitit.ring.middleware.parameters :as parameters]
            [reitit.ring.middleware.muuntaja :as muuntaja]
            [muuntaja.core :as m]))

(def User [:map [:id :int] [:name :string] [:email :string]])

(def routes
  [["/swagger.json"
    {:get {:no-doc true
           :swagger {:info {:title "My API"
                            :version "1.0.0"
                            :description "REST API documentation"}
                     :securityDefinitions {:bearer {:type "apiKey"
                                                    :name "Authorization"
                                                    :in "header"}}}
           :handler (swagger/create-swagger-handler)}}]
   
   ["/api"
    {:swagger {:tags ["api"]}}
    ["/health"
     {:get {:summary "Health check"
            :swagger {:tags ["system"]}
            :responses {200 {:body {:status :string}}}
            :handler (fn [_] {:status 200 :body {:status "ok"}})}}]
    
    ["/users"
     {:swagger {:tags ["users"]}}
     ["" {:get {:summary "List users"
                :responses {200 {:body [:vector User]}}
                :handler list-users}
           :post {:summary "Create user"
                  :parameters {:body [:map [:name :string] [:email :string]]}
                  :responses {201 {:body User}}
                  :handler create-user}}]]]])

(def app
  (ring/ring-handler
    (ring/router
      routes
      {:data {:coercion malli/coercion
              :muuntaja m/instance
              :middleware [parameters/parameters-middleware
                           muuntaja/format-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-request-middleware
                           coercion/coerce-response-middleware]}})
    (ring/routes
      (swagger-ui/create-swagger-ui-handler {:path "/docs"})
      (ring/create-default-handler))))
```
